records.recommendation: A July 2026 Mississippi Today article quotes xAI saying it is constructing a 1.2 gigawatt power plant under its air permit, which could mean unit 2 has moved from pre-construction to construction. records.recommendation: The Solaris Energy Infrastructure quarterly report for June 2026 says Solaris holds 50.1 percent of Stateline Power LLC and MZX Tech LLC holds the other 49.9 percent. Stateline was formed in April 2025 to provide off-grid power under a long-term equipment lease to MZX Tech LLC, and it borrowed money to buy the equipment. So the leased generating equipment may be owned by Stateline, not by MZX Tech LLC. The filing does not say which turbines, how many megawatts, or whether they sit at Southaven or in Memphis. I did not change the owner. The May 2026 row on the possible-updates sheet about a change of ownership is answered this way: I found no closed sale of the plant, only this lease structure.
